```{python}
            "Rater_Benchmark_Supplement_Tables.xlsx",
            "Supplementary methods tables",
            "generated rater benchmark supplement tables",
            "rater",
        ),
        (
            "NLP_Classifier_Supplement_Tables.xlsx",
            "Supplementary methods tables",
            "generated NLP classifier supplement tables",
            "classifier",
        ),
    ]

    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for filename, manuscript_location, included_reason in main_display_assets:
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                filename,
                location="main_manuscript",
                asset_type="table" if filename.endswith(".xlsx") else "figure",
                manuscript_location=manuscript_location,
                included_reason=included_reason,
            )
        )
    for filename, manuscript_location, paired_display_asset, included_reason in main_source_assets:
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                filename,
                location="main_source_data",
                asset_type="source_data",
                manuscript_location=manuscript_location,
                paired_display_asset=paired_display_asset,
                included_reason=included_reason,
            )
        )
    for filename, manuscript_location, included_reason in supplement_display_assets:
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                filename,
                location="supplement",
                asset_type="figure",
                manuscript_location=manuscript_location,
                included_reason=included_reason,
            )
        )
    for filename, manuscript_location, paired_display_asset, included_reason in supplement_source_assets:
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                filename,
                location="supplement_source_data",
                asset_type="source_data",
                manuscript_location=manuscript_location,
                paired_display_asset=paired_display_asset,
                included_reason=included_reason,
            )
        )
    for filename, manuscript_location, included_reason, producer_stage in supplement_table_assets:
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                filename,
                location="supplement",
                asset_type="table",
                manuscript_location=manuscript_location,
                included_reason=included_reason,
                required_asset=False,
                producer_stage=producer_stage,
            )
        )
    return rows


def validate_submission_asset_bundle(
    bundle_dir: Path,
    manifest_df: pd.DataFrame,
    missing_optional_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Validate that the submission bundle contains only clean allowlisted assets."""

    required_columns = {
        "destination_filename",
        "source_filename",
        "location",
        "asset_type",
        "manuscript_location",
        "included_reason",
        "required_asset",
        "producer_stage",
    }
    missing_columns = sorted(required_columns.difference(manifest_df.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest missing columns: {missing_columns}")

    expected_files = set(manifest_df["destination_filename"].astype(str))
    actual_files = {path.name for path in bundle_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    expected_with_manifest = expected_files | {SUBMISSION_ASSET_MANIFEST_FILENAME}
    if actual_files != expected_with_manifest:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"submission_assets file mismatch: expected {sorted(expected_with_manifest)}, got {sorted(actual_files)}"
        )

    manifest_destinations = manifest_df["destination_filename"].astype(str)
    if manifest_destinations.duplicated().any():
        duplicates = sorted(manifest_destinations.loc[manifest_destinations.duplicated()].unique().tolist())
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest has duplicate destinations: {duplicates}")

    forbidden_pattern = re.compile("|".join(SUBMISSION_FORBIDDEN_ASSET_PATTERNS), flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    forbidden_hits = sorted(filename for filename in expected_files if forbidden_pattern.search(filename))
    if forbidden_hits:
        raise AssertionError(f"submission_assets contains forbidden exploratory outputs: {forbidden_hits}")

    allowed_locations = {"main_manuscript", "main_source_data", "supplement", "supplement_source_data"}
    unsupported_locations = sorted(set(manifest_df["location"]).difference(allowed_locations))
    if unsupported_locations:
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest has unsupported locations: {unsupported_locations}")

    if missing_optional_df is None:
        return

    optional_required_columns = {"source_filename", "producer_stage", "expected_results_dir", "reason"}
    missing_optional_columns = sorted(optional_required_columns.difference(missing_optional_df.columns))
    if missing_optional_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Optional-missing asset audit missing columns: {missing_optional_columns}")
    if missing_optional_df.empty:
        return

    missing_optional_sources = set(missing_optional_df["source_filename"].astype(str))
    undeclared_optional_assets = sorted(missing_optional_sources.difference(SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_UPSTREAM_FILENAMES))
    if undeclared_optional_assets:
        raise AssertionError(f"Missing optional submission assets are not declared upstream assets: {undeclared_optional_assets}")
    copied_and_missing = sorted(missing_optional_sources.intersection(set(manifest_df["source_filename"].astype(str))))
    if copied_and_missing:
        raise AssertionError(f"Submission assets cannot be both copied and missing: {copied_and_missing}")
    unexpected_reasons = sorted(
        set(missing_optional_df["reason"].astype(str)).difference({"optional_upstream_asset_missing"})
    )
    if unexpected_reasons:
        raise ValueError(f"Optional-missing asset audit has unsupported reasons: {unexpected_reasons}")


def build_submission_asset_bundle(
    output_dir: Path = OUTPUT_DIR,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, pd.DataFrame, Path | None, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Copy the clean manuscript/supplement submission asset allowlist into one directory."""

    bundle_dir = output_dir / SUBMISSION_ASSET_DIRNAME
    if bundle_dir.exists() and not bundle_dir.is_dir():
        raise NotADirectoryError(f"Expected submission asset directory, found file: {bundle_dir}")
    if bundle_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(bundle_dir)
    bundle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    rows = []
    missing_optional_rows = []
    for spec in build_submission_asset_allowlist():
        source_filename = str(spec["source_filename"])
        source_path = output_dir / source_filename
        if not source_path.exists():
            if bool(spec.get("required_asset", True)):
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing required allowlisted submission asset: {source_path}")
            if source_filename not in SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_UPSTREAM_FILENAMES:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing undeclared optional submission asset: {source_path}")
            missing_optional_rows.append(
                {
                    "source_filename": source_filename,
                    "producer_stage": str(spec.get("producer_stage", "")),
                    "expected_results_dir": display_path(output_dir),
                    "reason": "optional_upstream_asset_missing",
                }
            )
            continue
        destination_path = bundle_dir / str(spec["destination_filename"])
        if destination_path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Duplicate submission asset destination: {destination_path.name}")
        shutil.copy2(source_path, destination_path)
        rows.append(
            {
                **spec,
                "copied_relative_path": f"{SUBMISSION_ASSET_DIRNAME}/{destination_path.name}",
                "source_relative_path": source_path.name,
                "size_bytes": int(destination_path.stat().st_size),
            }
        )

    manifest_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    manifest_path = bundle_dir / SUBMISSION_ASSET_MANIFEST_FILENAME
    manifest_df.to_csv(manifest_path, index=False)

    missing_optional_df = pd.DataFrame(
        missing_optional_rows,
        columns=["source_filename", "producer_stage", "expected_results_dir", "reason"],
    )
    missing_optional_path = ANALYSIS_QA_DIR / SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_MISSING_FILENAME
    if missing_optional_df.empty:
        quiet_unlink(missing_optional_path, verbose=VERBOSE_RENDER)
        analysis_export_registry.pop("submission_asset_optional_missing", None)
        missing_optional_path_or_none: Path | None = None
    else:
        ANALYSIS_QA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        missing_optional_df.to_csv(missing_optional_path, index=False)
        missing_optional_path_or_none = missing_optional_path

    validate_submission_asset_bundle(bundle_dir, manifest_df, missing_optional_df)

    register_export(
        key="submission_assets_dir",
        output_path=bundle_dir,
        builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
        artifact_kind="directory",
        scope="submission",
        formats=["directory"],
    )
    register_export(
        key="submission_asset_manifest",
        output_path=manifest_path,
        builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
        artifact_kind="manifest",
        scope="submission",
        formats=["csv"],
    )
    if missing_optional_path_or_none is not None:
        register_export(
            key="submission_asset_optional_missing",
            output_path=missing_optional_path_or_none,
            builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
            artifact_kind="qa",
            scope="qa",
            formats=["csv"],
        )
    return bundle_dir, manifest_path, manifest_df, missing_optional_path_or_none, missing_optional_df


def classify_compensation(ph: float) -> str | float:
    """Map minimum 24h pH to the manuscript compensation groups."""

    if pd.isna(ph):
        return np.nan
    if ph >= 7.35:
        return "Compensated"
    if ph >= 7.30:
        return "Mild acidemia"
    if ph >= 7.25:
        return "Moderate acidemia"
    return "Severe acidemia"


def classify_acuity_group(value: object) -> str | float:
    """Collapse ESI triage values to high/moderate/low acuity."""

    acuity = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([value]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    if pd.isna(acuity):
        return np.nan
    if acuity in {1, 2}:
        return "High acuity"
    if acuity == 3:
        return "Moderate acuity"
    return "Low acuity"


def derive_etiology_group(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Apply the manuscript etiology hierarchy used in the former Reyan workflow."""

    opioid = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_opioid_substance"]))
    neuro = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_neuromuscular"]))
    ohs = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_osa_ohs"]))
    copd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_copd"]))
    chf = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_chf"]))
    pneumonia = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_pneumonia"]))

    labels = np.select(
        [
            opioid.eq(1),
            neuro.eq(1),
            ohs.eq(1),
            copd.eq(1),
            chf.eq(1),
            pneumonia.eq(1),
        ],
        [
            "Opioid",
            "Neuromuscular",
            "OHS",
            "COPD",
            "CHF",
            "Infection (Pneumonia)",
        ],
        default="Other/Unclassified",
    )
    return pd.Series(labels, index=df.index, name="etiology_group")


def derive_qualifying_site(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Approximate the qualifying gas site using the canonical workbook columns."""

    specimen = maybe_series(df, ["first_gas_specimen_type"]).astype("string").str.upper()
    site = pd.Series("UNKNOWN", index=df.index, dtype="string")
    site = site.mask(specimen.str.contains("ART", na=False), "ABG")
    site = site.mask(specimen.str.contains("VEN", na=False), "VBG")

    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_pco2"]).eq(maybe_numeric(df, ["first_abg_pco2"])),
        "ABG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_pco2"]).eq(maybe_numeric(df, ["first_vbg_pco2"])),
        "VBG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_other_pco2"]).notna(),
        "UNKNOWN",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN")
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(0),
        "ABG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN")
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(0),
        "VBG",
    )
    return site.rename("qualifying_site_group")


def derive_ph_severity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Recreate the acidemia severity labels used for the manuscript severity figure."""

    lab_ph = maybe_numeric(df, ["lab_abg_ph"])
    lab_ph = lab_ph.where(lab_ph.notna(), maybe_numeric(df, ["lab_vbg_ph"]))
    lab_ph = lab_ph.where(lab_ph.notna(), maybe_numeric(df, ["first_ph", "min_ph_0_24h"]))

    severity = np.select(
        [
            lab_ph.ge(7.35),
            lab_ph.between(7.30, 7.34, inclusive="both"),
            lab_ph.between(7.25, 7.29, inclusive="both"),
            lab_ph.lt(7.25),
        ],
        [
            "Normal/Compensated (>=7.35)",
            "Mild (7.30-7.34)",
            "Moderate (7.25-7.29)",
            "Severe (<7.25)",
        ],
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(severity, index=df.index, name="ph_severity")


def classify_timing_group(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Recreate the early/late/no acidemia grouping used for the manuscript timing figure."""

    min_6h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_6h"])
    min_24h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_24h"])

    labels = np.select(
        [
            min_6h.lt(7.35),
            min_6h.ge(7.35) & min_24h.lt(7.35),
            min_24h.ge(7.35),
        ],
        ["Early acidemia", "Late acidemia", "No acidemia"],
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(labels, index=df.index, name="timing_group")


TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR = "median [IQR]"
TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT = "n (%)"
TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES = {TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR, TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT}
TABLE1_COMMA_NUMERAL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\d,\d")
TABLE1_MEDIAN_IQR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)? \[-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?--?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\]$")
TABLE1_COUNT_PCT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\d+ \(\d+(?:\.\d+)?%\)$")


def table1_row(
    characteristic: str,
    column: str,
    summary_type: str,
    category_value: object | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Define one publication Table 1 row with explicit summary semantics."""

    if summary_type not in TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Table 1 summary type: {summary_type!r}")
    return {
        "Characteristic": characteristic,
        "column": column,
        "Summary type": summary_type,
        "category_value": category_value,
    }


def summarize_table1_cell(frame: pd.DataFrame, row_spec: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    """Return one Table 1 cell from explicit row metadata."""

    column = str(row_spec["column"])
    summary_type = str(row_spec["Summary type"])
    series = frame[column]
    if summary_type == TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR:
        return format_median_iqr(series)
    if summary_type == TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT:
        category_value = row_spec.get("category_value")
        if category_value is None:
            count = int(to_binary_flag(series).eq(1).sum())
        else:
            count = int(series.eq(category_value).sum())
        return format_count_pct_no_commas(count, len(frame))
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Table 1 summary type: {summary_type!r}")


def validate_table1_output(table: pd.DataFrame, *, table_name: str) -> None:
    """Fail before export if Table 1 display contracts are violated."""

    required_columns = {"Characteristic", "Summary type"}
    missing_columns = sorted(required_columns.difference(table.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} missing required columns: {missing_columns}")
    unsupported_types = sorted(set(table["Summary type"]).difference(TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES))
    if unsupported_types:
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has unsupported summary types: {unsupported_types}")
    string_table = table.astype(str)
    comma_hits = string_table.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_COMMA_NUMERAL_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    if comma_hits.to_numpy().any():
        hit_rows, hit_cols = np.where(comma_hits.to_numpy())
        examples = [
            f"{table.columns[col]}={string_table.iat[row, col]}"
            for row, col in zip(hit_rows[:5], hit_cols[:5], strict=False)
        ]
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} contains comma-formatted numerals: {examples}")

    value_columns = [column for column in table.columns if column not in {"Characteristic", "Summary type"}]
    count_rows = table["Summary type"].eq(TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT)
    median_rows = table["Summary type"].eq(TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR)
    count_values = table.loc[count_rows, value_columns].astype(str)
    median_values = table.loc[median_rows, value_columns].astype(str)
    count_as_median = count_values.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_MEDIAN_IQR_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    median_as_count = median_values.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_COUNT_PCT_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    if count_as_median.to_numpy().any():
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has n (%) rows displayed as median [IQR].")
    if median_as_count.to_numpy().any():
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has median [IQR] rows displayed as n (%).")


def build_table1_frame(
    row_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    group_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    *,
    table_name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build one publication Table 1 workbook sheet from explicit row specs."""

    required_columns = sorted({str(row["column"]) for row in row_specs})
    for group_name, frame in group_frames.items():
        try:
            ensure_required_columns(frame, required_columns)
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise KeyError(f"{table_name} source columns missing for group '{group_name}'.") from exc
    rows = []
    for row_spec in row_specs:
        output_row = {
            "Characteristic": str(row_spec["Characteristic"]),
            "Summary type": str(row_spec["Summary type"]),
        }
        for group_name, frame in group_frames.items():
            output_row[f"{group_name} (N={len(frame)})"] = summarize_table1_cell(frame, row_spec)
        rows.append(output_row)
    table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    validate_table1_output(table, table_name=table_name)
    return table


def format_table1_excel(path: Path) -> None:
    """Apply copy-paste-friendly Excel formatting to publication Table 1 workbooks."""

    workbook = load_workbook(path)
    header_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E6EDF3")
    for worksheet in workbook.worksheets:
        if worksheet.merged_cells.ranges:
            raise ValueError(f"{path.name} has merged cells on sheet '{worksheet.title}'.")
        worksheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
        worksheet.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
        for cell in worksheet[1]:
            cell.font = Font(bold=True)
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        for row in worksheet.iter_rows(min_row=2):
            for cell in row:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        for column_cells in worksheet.columns:
            column_letter = column_cells[0].column_letter
            max_length = max(len(str(cell.value)) if cell.value is not None else 0 for cell in column_cells)
            if column_letter == "A":
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 28), 52)
            elif column_letter == "B":
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = 16
            else:
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 18), 26)
    workbook.save(path)


def model_or_table(model: object) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Convert a fitted logistic model to a tidy OR table."""

    params = model.params
    conf = model.conf_int()
    out = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "OR": np.exp(params),
            "LCI": np.exp(conf[0]),
            "UCI": np.exp(conf[1]),
            "p_value": model.pvalues,
        }
    )
    return out


def publication_table(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Format a tidy OR table for manuscript-export publication use."""

    out = df.copy()
    out["OR (95% CI)"] = out.apply(
        lambda row: f"{row['OR']:.2f} ({row['LCI']:.2f}-{row['UCI']:.2f})",
        axis=1,
    )
    out["p_value"] = out["p_value"].map(lambda value: f"{value:.3f}")
    return out.reset_index(names="Predictor")


def render_dataframe_pdf(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    output_path: Path,
    *,
    title: str,
    font_size: int = 8,
    scale_x: float = 1.1,
    scale_y: float = 1.18,
) -> Path:
    """Render a dataframe to a simple PDF table using matplotlib for manuscript assets."""

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    display_df = frame.copy()
    display_df.columns = [str(column) for column in display_df.columns]
    n_rows = max(len(display_df), 1)
    fig_height = min(max(2.8, 0.32 * n_rows + 1.6), 18)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, fig_height))
    ax.axis("off")
    if title:
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["title_size"], fontweight="bold", pad=12)
    table = ax.table(
        cellText=display_df.fillna("").astype(str).values,
        colLabels=display_df.columns.tolist(),
        loc="center",
        cellLoc="left",
    )
    table.auto_set_font_size(False)
    table.set_fontsize(font_size)
    table.scale(scale_x, scale_y)
    for (row_idx, _), cell in table.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor("#d9dde3")
        if row_idx == 0:
            cell.set_facecolor("#e6edf3")
            cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
    return output_path


def write_pdf_table_export(
    key: str,
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    builder: str,
    font_size: int = 8,
    scale_x: float = 1.1,
    scale_y: float = 1.18,
) -> Path:
    """Render one PDF table artifact and register it in the unified export registry."""

    output_path, scope, manuscript_asset_name = resolve_export_target(key)
    render_dataframe_pdf(
        frame,
        output_path,
        title=title,
        font_size=font_size,
        scale_x=scale_x,
        scale_y=scale_y,
    )
    register_export(
        key=key,
        output_path=output_path,
        builder=builder,
        artifact_kind="table",
        scope=scope,
        formats=["pdf"],
        manuscript_asset_name=manuscript_asset_name,
    )
    return output_path

analytic_df["rfv_primary_group_sensitivity"] = analytic_df[RFV_PRIMARY_COL_SENSITIVITY].apply(
    normalize_rfv_group
)
rfv_label_artifacts = build_rfv_label_artifacts(analytic_df)
encounter_level_rfv = rfv_label_artifacts["encounter_level"].drop(columns=["encounter_id"])
analytic_df = analytic_df.join(encounter_level_rfv)
rfv_membership_long = rfv_label_artifacts["analytical_membership_long"]
rfv_semantic_membership_long = rfv_label_artifacts["semantic_membership_long"]
rfv_group_membership_long = rfv_label_artifacts["grouped_membership_long"]
rfv_indicator_df = rfv_label_artifacts["analytical_indicators"]
rfv_semantic_indicator_df = rfv_label_artifacts["semantic_indicators"]
rfv_group_indicator_df = rfv_label_artifacts["grouped_indicators"]
rfv_label_coverage_audit = rfv_label_artifacts["label_coverage_audit"]
rfv_uncodable_diagnostics = rfv_label_artifacts["uncodable_diagnostics"]
rfv_uncodable_detail = rfv_label_artifacts["uncodable_detail"]
analytic_df["has_group_respiratory"] = (
    rfv_group_indicator_df.get(
        "Respiratory",
        pd.Series(0, index=analytic_df.index, dtype="int64"),
    )
    .astype("int64")
)

fallback_inclusion_route = classify_inclusion_type_vectorized(
    analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"],
    analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"],
)
if "enrollment_route" in analytic_df.columns:
    enrollment_route_map = (
        analytic_df["enrollment_route"]
        .astype("string")
        .str.strip()
        .str.upper()
        .map(
            {
                "ICD+GAS": "Both",
                "ICD_ONLY": "ICD_only",
                "GAS_ONLY": "Gas_only",
            }
        )
    )
    analytic_df["inclusion_route"] = enrollment_route_map.fillna(fallback_inclusion_route)
else:
    analytic_df["inclusion_route"] = fallback_inclusion_route

analytic_df["ed_anchor_time"] = maybe_datetime(analytic_df, ["ed_intime", "ed_intime_first", "admittime"])
analytic_df["qualifying_pco2_time"] = maybe_datetime(analytic_df, ["qualifying_pco2_time", "first_gas_time"])
analytic_df["first_imv_time"] = maybe_datetime(analytic_df, ["first_imv_time"])
analytic_df["first_niv_time"] = maybe_datetime(analytic_df, ["first_niv_time"])
analytic_df["qualifying_pco2_mmhg"] = maybe_numeric(
    analytic_df,
    ["qualifying_pco2_mmhg", "first_pco2", "max_pco2_0_24h"],
)
analytic_df["qualifying_site_group"] = derive_qualifying_site(analytic_df)

age = maybe_numeric(analytic_df, ["age"])
analytic_df["AgeGroup"] = np.select(
    [
        age.lt(40),
        age.between(40, 64, inclusive="both"),
        age.between(65, 79, inclusive="both"),
        age.ge(80),
    ],
    ["18–39 (Young)", "40–64 (Middle-aged)", "65–79 (Older)", "80+ (Elderly)"],
    default="Unknown",
)
analytic_df["time_to_gas_hrs"] = hours_between(analytic_df["qualifying_pco2_time"], analytic_df["ed_anchor_time"])
analytic_df["time_to_imv_hrs"] = hours_between(analytic_df["first_imv_time"], analytic_df["ed_anchor_time"])
analytic_df["time_to_niv_hrs"] = hours_between(analytic_df["first_niv_time"], analytic_df["ed_anchor_time"])
analytic_df["etiology_group"] = derive_etiology_group(analytic_df)
analytic_df["ph_severity"] = derive_ph_severity(analytic_df)
analytic_df["timing_group"] = classify_timing_group(analytic_df)
analytic_df["comp_group"] = maybe_numeric(analytic_df, ["min_ph_0_24h"]).apply(classify_compensation)
analytic_df["acuity_group"] = maybe_series(analytic_df, ["ed_triage_acuity"]).apply(classify_acuity_group)
analytic_df["Cohort"] = np.select(
    [
        analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"].eq(1) & analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"].eq(1),
        analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"].eq(1) & analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"].eq(0),
        analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"].eq(0) & analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"].eq(1),
    ],
    [
        "Recognized (Biochem+/ICD+)",
        "Unrecognized (Biochem+/ICD-)",
        "False Positive (Biochem-/ICD+)",
    ],
    default="Control (Biochem-/ICD-)",
)

biochemical_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"].eq(1)].copy()
icd_positive_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"].eq(1)].copy()
abg_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["abg_hypercap_threshold"].eq(1)].copy()
vbg_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["vbg_hypercap_threshold"].eq(1)].copy()
other_gas_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["unknown_hypercap_threshold"].eq(1)].copy()
both_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["inclusion_route"].eq("Both")].copy()
icd_only_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["inclusion_route"].eq("ICD_only")].copy()
gas_only_df = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["inclusion_route"].eq("Gas_only")].copy()

assert len(analytic_df) == len(input_df)
assert len(biochemical_df) == int(analytic_df["pco2_threshold_any"].sum())
assert len(icd_positive_df) == int(analytic_df["any_hypercap_icd"].sum())
assert len(icd_positive_df) + len(gas_only_df) == len(analytic_df)
assert analytic_df["label_count"].between(0, 5).all()
assert not (
    analytic_df["analytical_label_set"].map(lambda labels: RFV_UNCODABLE_LABEL in labels and len(labels) > 1)
).any()
assert not (
    analytic_df["has_uncodable_only"].eq(1)
    & analytic_df["semantic_group_set"].map(len).ne(0)
).any()
assert bool(rfv_label_coverage_audit["covered_by_mapping"].all())

RFV_COMORBIDITY_BASE_COHORT = analytic_df
rfv_comorbidity_grouped, rfv_comorbidity_denominators = summarize_rfv_prevalence_by_comorbidity(
    RFV_COMORBIDITY_BASE_COHORT,
    grouped=True,
)
rfv_comorbidity_full, rfv_comorbidity_full_denominators = summarize_rfv_prevalence_by_comorbidity(
    RFV_COMORBIDITY_BASE_COHORT,
    grouped=False,
)
assert rfv_comorbidity_denominators.equals(rfv_comorbidity_full_denominators)
rfv_comorbidity_absolute_differences = pd.concat(
    [
        rfv_comorbidity_grouped[
            ["representation", "flag_column", "flag_label", "category", "absolute_difference_pp"]
        ],
        rfv_comorbidity_full[
            ["representation", "flag_column", "flag_label", "category", "absolute_difference_pp"]
        ],
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)
rfv_comorbidity_notes = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "note": [
            "Base cohort is RFV_COMORBIDITY_BASE_COHORT = analytic_df.",
            "RFV prevalence is encounter-level multi-label prevalence across RFV1_name..RFV5_name.",
            "Rows are not mutually exclusive; percentages need not sum to 100% within a comorbidity stratum.",
            "absolute_difference_pp is pct_flag_encounters_with_category minus pct_no_flag_encounters_with_category.",
        ]
    }
)
rfv_comorbidity_workbook_path = write_excel_export(
    "rfv_prevalence_by_comorbidity",
    {
        "grouped_multilabel": rfv_comorbidity_grouped,
        "full_multilabel": rfv_comorbidity_full,
        "flag_denominators": rfv_comorbidity_denominators,
        "absolute_differences": rfv_comorbidity_absolute_differences,
        "notes": rfv_comorbidity_notes,
    },
    builder="summarize_rfv_prevalence_by_comorbidity",
)
note_export(rfv_comorbidity_workbook_path)
rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_fig = plot_comorbidity_rfv_heatmap(rfv_comorbidity_grouped)
rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_path = save_and_render_figure(
    rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_fig,
    "rfv_prevalence_by_comorbidity_heatmap",
)
note_export(rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_path)

df = analytic_df

if os.getenv("VERBOSE_RENDER", "").strip() == "1":
    print(
        f"Loaded {ANALYSIS_INPUT_PATH.name}: {analytic_df.shape[0]:,} rows x {analytic_df.shape[1]:,} columns"
    )
    print(f"Analytic cohort rows: {len(analytic_df):,}")
    print(f"Biochemical subset rows: {len(biochemical_df):,}")
    print(f"ICD-positive rows: {len(icd_positive_df):,}")
    print(f"RFV slots detected: {rfv_name_cols}")
```

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-003b
vital_preference_specs = {
    "triage_temp_f": ("ed_triage_temp_f_clean", "ed_triage_temp"),
    "first_temp_f": ("ed_first_temp_f_clean", "ed_first_temp"),
    "triage_pain": ("ed_triage_pain_clean", "ed_triage_pain"),
    "first_pain": ("ed_first_pain_clean", "ed_first_pain"),
    "triage_sbp": ("ed_triage_sbp_clean", "ed_triage_sbp"),
    "first_sbp": ("ed_first_sbp_clean", "ed_first_sbp"),
    "triage_dbp": ("ed_triage_dbp_clean", "ed_triage_dbp"),
    "first_dbp": ("ed_first_dbp_clean", "ed_first_dbp"),
    "triage_o2sat": ("ed_triage_o2sat_clean", "ed_triage_o2sat"),
    "first_o2sat": ("ed_first_o2sat_clean", "ed_first_o2sat"),
}

selected_vital_columns: dict[str, str | None] = {}
vitals_quality_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
for vital_name, (clean_col, fallback_col) in vital_preference_specs.items():
    selected_column = select_preferred_vital_column(
        df,
        clean_column=clean_col,
        fallback_model_column=fallback_col,
    )
    selected_vital_columns[vital_name] = selected_column
    if selected_column is None:
        vitals_quality_rows.append(
            {
                "vital_name": vital_name,
                "selected_column": None,
                "n_non_missing": 0,
                "median": np.nan,
                "mean": np.nan,
            }
        )
        continue
    numeric = pd.to_numeric(df[selected_column], errors="coerce")
    vitals_quality_rows.append(
        {
            "vital_name": vital_name,
            "selected_column": selected_column,
            "n_non_missing": int(numeric.notna().sum()),
            "median": float(numeric.median()) if numeric.notna().any() else np.nan,
            "mean": float(numeric.mean()) if numeric.notna().any() else np.nan,
        }
    )

vitals_quality_summary = pd.DataFrame(vitals_quality_rows).sort_values("vital_name")
display(vitals_quality_summary)

print(
    "Cohort-run ED vitals audits are written under "
    "'MIMIC tabular data/prior runs/YYYY-MM-DD ed_vitals_*.csv'."
)
```

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-003c
qa_summary_path = WORK_DIR / "artifacts" / "qa" / "cohort" / "qa_summary.json"
if qa_summary_path.exists():
    qa_summary_payload = json.loads(qa_summary_path.read_text())
    blood_gas_audit_paths = qa_summary_payload.get("blood_gas_audit_paths", {})
    timing_integrity_audit = qa_summary_payload.get("timing_integrity_audit", [{}])
    ventilation_timing_audit = qa_summary_payload.get("ventilation_timing_audit", [{}])
    timing_row = timing_integrity_audit[0] if timing_integrity_audit else {}
    vent_row = ventilation_timing_audit[0] if ventilation_timing_audit else {}
    qualifying_gas_time_observed_rate = (
        float(pd.to_numeric(df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"], errors="coerce").notna().mean())
        if "dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours" in df.columns
        else None
    )
    timing_rows_total = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series([timing_row.get("rows_total")]),
        errors="coerce",
    ).iloc[0]
    timing_usable_n = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series([timing_row.get("timing_usable_for_model_n")]),
        errors="coerce",
    ).iloc[0]
    timing_usable_for_model_rate = (
        float(timing_usable_n / timing_rows_total)
        if pd.notna(timing_rows_total)
        and timing_rows_total > 0
        and pd.notna(timing_usable_n)
        else (
            float(pd.to_numeric(df.get("timing_usable_for_model"), errors="coerce").fillna(0).mean())
            if "timing_usable_for_model" in df.columns

            ),
        },
        {

            "value": (
                qa_summary_payload.get("other_route_quarantine_audit", [{}])[0].get(
                    "poc_other_leak_into_other_threshold_n"

                if qa_summary_payload.get("other_route_quarantine_audit")

            ),
```

## Symptom Composition By Hypercapnia Definition

Generate encounter-level multi-label prevalence summaries. Each encounter contributes once to every RFV category present across `RFV1_name..RFV5_name`, so percentages are not mutually exclusive and may exceed 100 when summed across categories.

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-006
definition_frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
for definition in HYPERCAP_CRITERIA:
    definition_subset = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df[definition].eq(1)].copy()
    if definition_subset.empty:
        continue
    definition_subset["Hypercapnia_Definition"] = definition
    definition_summary = summarize_multilabel_prevalence(
        definition_subset,
        strata="Hypercapnia_Definition",
    )
    definition_frames.append(definition_summary)

definition_counts_df = pd.concat(definition_frames, ignore_index=True)
definition_counts_df = add_wilson_ci(definition_counts_df)
definition_counts_df["Definition_Label"] = definition_counts_df["Hypercapnia_Definition"].map(
    prevalence_label_map
).fillna(definition_counts_df["Hypercapnia_Definition"])
definition_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"] = definition_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"].round(2)
definition_counts_df["CI_lower"] = definition_counts_df["CI_lower"].round(2)
definition_counts_df["CI_upper"] = definition_counts_df["CI_upper"].round(2)
definition_counts_df = definition_counts_df.sort_values(
    ["Hypercapnia_Definition", "n_with_category", "category"],
    ascending=[True, False, True],
)

definition_pivot_df = (
    definition_counts_df.pivot_table(
        index="category",
        columns="Definition_Label",
        values="pct_of_encounters",
        fill_value=0,
        observed=False,
    )
    .round(2)
)

    key="symptom_composition_by_hypercap_definition",

)
```

## Symptom Composition By Blood-Gas Hypercapnia Timing

Create timing-stratified multi-label symptom summaries for gas-positive encounters only.
Timing strata are non-overlapping:
- `<6h` from ED presentation,
- `6–24h`,
- `>24h`.

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-008b
timing_required = ["pco2_threshold_any", "dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"]
ensure_required_columns(biochemical_df, timing_required)

timing_df = biochemical_df.copy()
timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"] = pd.to_numeric(
    timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"],
    errors="coerce",
)
timing_df = timing_df.loc[timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"].notna()].copy()

timing_df["gas_timing_stratum"] = np.select(
    [
        timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"].lt(6),
        timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"].between(6, 24, inclusive="both"),
        timing_df["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours"].gt(24),
    ],
    ["<6h", "6-24h", ">24h"],
    default="UNCLASSIFIED",
)
timing_df = timing_df.loc[~timing_df["gas_timing_stratum"].eq("UNCLASSIFIED")].copy()
timing_order = ["<6h", "6-24h", ">24h"]

timing_counts_df = summarize_multilabel_prevalence(
    timing_df,
    strata="gas_timing_stratum",
)
timing_counts_df = add_wilson_ci(timing_counts_df)
timing_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"] = timing_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"].round(2)
timing_counts_df["CI_lower"] = timing_counts_df["CI_lower"].round(2)
timing_counts_df["CI_upper"] = timing_counts_df["CI_upper"].round(2)
timing_counts_df = timing_counts_df.sort_values(
    ["gas_timing_stratum", "n_with_category", "category"],
    ascending=[True, False, True],
)
timing_counts_df["gas_timing_stratum"] = pd.Categorical(
    timing_counts_df["gas_timing_stratum"],
    categories=timing_order,
    ordered=True,
)
timing_counts_df = timing_counts_df.sort_values(
    ["gas_timing_stratum", "n_with_category", "category"],
    ascending=[True, False, True],
)

timing_pivot_df = timing_counts_df.pivot_table(
    index="category",
    columns="gas_timing_stratum",
    values="pct_of_encounters",
    fill_value=0,
    observed=False,
).round(2)

timing_output_path = write_excel_export(
    key="symptom_composition_by_gas_timing",
    filename="Symptom_Composition_by_Gas_Timing.xlsx",
    builder="summarize_multilabel_prevalence_by_gas_timing",
    sheets=[
        {"sheet_name": "Prevalence_Tidy", "df": timing_counts_df, "index": False},
        {"sheet_name": "ChartReady_Pivot", "df": timing_pivot_df.reset_index(), "index": False},
    ],
)
note_export(timing_output_path)

timing_plot_df = timing_pivot_df.loc[
    timing_counts_df.groupby("category")["n_with_category"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).index
].T.reindex(timing_order)
timing_category_order = (
    timing_counts_df.groupby("category")["n_with_category"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
)
timing_prevalence_panel_plot_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "Symptom_Composition_by_Gas_Timing_Stacked.png"
plot_panelled_lollipop(
    timing_plot_df,
    facet_order=timing_order,
    category_order=timing_category_order[:10],
    title="Chief-complaint prevalence across blood-gas timing strata",
    x_label="Percent of encounters",
    filename=timing_prevalence_panel_plot_path.name,
    panel_titles={timing: timing for timing in timing_order},
)
note_export(timing_prevalence_panel_plot_path)

timing_top_for_ci = (
    timing_counts_df.groupby("category")["n_with_category"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(5)
    .index
)
timing_ci_plot_df = timing_counts_df.loc[timing_counts_df["category"].isin(timing_top_for_ci)].copy()
timing_symptom_order = list(timing_top_for_ci)

x = np.arange(len(timing_symptom_order))
width = 0.22

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6))

for idx, timing_label in enumerate(timing_order):
    subset = (
        timing_ci_plot_df.loc[timing_ci_plot_df["gas_timing_stratum"].eq(timing_label)]

        capsize=2,

    for bar in bars:

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(timing_symptom_order, rotation=25, ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("Percent of encounters")
```

## ICD Diagnostic Performance (ICD as predictor)

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-009b
performance_targets = [
    ("pco2_threshold_any", "Gas any-time"),
    ("pco2_threshold_0_24h", "Gas within 24h marker"),
    ("abg_hypercap_threshold", "ABG threshold"),
    ("vbg_hypercap_threshold", "VBG threshold"),
    ("unknown_hypercap_threshold", "PCO2 UNKNOWN threshold"),
]

icd_positive = to_binary_flag(df["any_hypercap_icd"])
performance_rows = []
for target_col, target_label in performance_targets:
    target_positive = to_binary_flag(df[target_col])
    tp = int(((icd_positive == 1) & (target_positive == 1)).sum())
    fp = int(((icd_positive == 1) & (target_positive == 0)).sum())
    fn = int(((icd_positive == 0) & (target_positive == 1)).sum())
    tn = int(((icd_positive == 0) & (target_positive == 0)).sum())

    sens_denom = tp + fn
    ppv_denom = tp + fp
    sensitivity = float(tp / sens_denom) if sens_denom else np.nan
    ppv = float(tp / ppv_denom) if ppv_denom else np.nan
    sens_ci = (
        proportion_confint(tp, sens_denom, alpha=0.05, method="wilson")
        if sens_denom
        else (np.nan, np.nan)
    )
    ppv_ci = (
        proportion_confint(tp, ppv_denom, alpha=0.05, method="wilson")
        if ppv_denom
        else (np.nan, np.nan)
    )
    performance_rows.append(
        {
            "Target": target_label,
            "Target_Column": target_col,
            "TP": tp,
            "FP": fp,
            "FN": fn,
            "TN": tn,
            "Sensitivity": sensitivity,
            "Sensitivity_CI_Lower": sens_ci[0],
            "Sensitivity_CI_Upper": sens_ci[1],
            "PPV": ppv,
            "PPV_CI_Lower": ppv_ci[0],
            "PPV_CI_Upper": ppv_ci[1],
        }
    )

icd_performance_df = pd.DataFrame(performance_rows)
icd_performance_df[[
    "Sensitivity",
    "Sensitivity_CI_Lower",
    "Sensitivity_CI_Upper",
    "PPV",
    "PPV_CI_Lower",
    "PPV_CI_Upper",
]] = icd_performance_df[[
    "Sensitivity",
    "Sensitivity_CI_Lower",
    "Sensitivity_CI_Upper",
    "PPV",
    "PPV_CI_Lower",
    "PPV_CI_Upper",
]].clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

icd_subset_output_path = write_excel_export(
    key="icd_positive_subset_breakdown",
    filename="ICD_Positive_Subset_Breakdown.xlsx",
    builder="build_icd_positive_subset_tables",
    sheets=[
        {"sheet_name": "Gas_criteria", "df": icd_positive_breakdown, "index": False},
        {
            "sheet_name": "ICD_categories",
            "df": icd_positive_category_summary.reset_index(),
            "index": False,
        },
    ],
)
icd_performance_output_path = write_excel_export(
    key="icd_vs_gas_performance",
    filename="ICD_vs_Gas_Performance.xlsx",
    builder="build_icd_performance_df",
    sheets=[
        {"sheet_name": "Sheet1", "df": icd_performance_df, "index": False},
    ],
)

display(icd_positive_breakdown)
display(icd_performance_df)
note_export(icd_subset_output_path)
note_export(icd_performance_output_path)
```

## CONSORT enrollment flow diagram (cohort construction counts)

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-009c3
#| echo: false
# Render a CONSORT-style enrollment flow focused on cohort requirements.
# This logic is embedded directly in this notebook (no external script dependency).
import subprocess
import textwrap
from IPython.display import Image, display

if "enrollment_route" not in analytic_df.columns:
    raise KeyError("Missing required column for CONSORT flow: enrollment_route")

flow_lookup = {
    str(key): int(value)
    for key, value in qa_summary_payload.get("cohort_flow_counts_lookup", {}).items()
}
if not flow_lookup and qa_summary_payload.get("cohort_flow_counts"):
    flow_lookup = {
        str(row.get("step")): int(row.get("count", 0))
        for row in qa_summary_payload.get("cohort_flow_counts", [])
        if row.get("step") is not None
    }

total_ed_encounters = int(
    flow_lookup.get(
        "Total ED encounters (edstays)",
        qa_summary_payload.get("ed_spine_rows", len(analytic_df)),
    )
)
ed_encounters_with_hadm = int(
    flow_lookup.get(
        "ED encounters with hadm_id",
        qa_summary_payload.get("ed_spine_rows", len(analytic_df)),
    )
)
hypercap_evidence_rows = int(
    flow_lookup.get(
        "Cohort admissions (union ICD ∪ thresholds)",
        qa_summary_payload.get("enrolled_any_n", len(analytic_df)),
    )
)
chief_complaint_present_rows = int(
    flow_lookup.get(
        "Cohort with ED chief complaint present",
        qa_summary_payload.get("ed_cc_rows", len(analytic_df)),
    )
)
final_study_rows = int(len(analytic_df))

consort_counts = {
    "total_ed_encounters": total_ed_encounters,
    "ed_encounters_with_hadm": ed_encounters_with_hadm,
    "excluded_no_hadm": max(total_ed_encounters - ed_encounters_with_hadm, 0),
    "hypercap_evidence_rows": hypercap_evidence_rows,
    "excluded_no_hypercap_evidence": max(
        ed_encounters_with_hadm - hypercap_evidence_rows,
        0,
    ),
    "chief_complaint_present_rows": chief_complaint_present_rows,
    "excluded_missing_or_pseudomissing_cc": max(
        hypercap_evidence_rows - chief_complaint_present_rows,
        0,
    ),
    "final_study_rows": final_study_rows,
}
consort_counts["excluded_after_cc_to_export"] = max(
    chief_complaint_present_rows - final_study_rows,
    0,
)

consort_artifact_dir = LEGACY_OUTPUT_ARCHIVE_DIR / "artifacts" / "consort"
consort_artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
consort_png_path = consort_artifact_dir / "CONSORT_Enrollment_Flow.png"
consort_counts_path = consort_artifact_dir / "CONSORT_Enrollment_Flow_Counts.csv"

r_code = textwrap.dedent(
    f"""
    required_pkgs <- c("consort")
    missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
    if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {{
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Missing required R packages: ",
          paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
          ". Install with install.packages(c(",
          paste(shQuote(missing_pkgs), collapse = ", "),
          ")) and rerun analysis."
        )
      )
    }}

    library(consort)
    fmt_n <- function(x) format(as.integer(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

    counts <- data.frame(
      metric = c(
        "total_ed_encounters",
        "ed_encounters_with_hadm",
        "excluded_no_hadm",
        "hypercap_evidence_rows",
        "excluded_no_hypercap_evidence",
        "chief_complaint_present_rows",
        "excluded_missing_or_pseudomissing_cc",
        "final_study_rows",
        "excluded_after_cc_to_export"
      ),
      count = c(
        {consort_counts["total_ed_encounters"]},
        {consort_counts["ed_encounters_with_hadm"]},
        {consort_counts["excluded_no_hadm"]},
        {consort_counts["hypercap_evidence_rows"]},
        {consort_counts["excluded_no_hypercap_evidence"]},
        {consort_counts["chief_complaint_present_rows"]},
        {consort_counts["excluded_missing_or_pseudomissing_cc"]},
        {consort_counts["final_study_rows"]},
        {consort_counts["excluded_after_cc_to_export"]}
      )
    )

    utils::write.csv(counts, "{consort_counts_path.as_posix()}", row.names = FALSE)

    entry_txt <- sprintf("MIMIC-IV ED encounters (all edstays)\\n(n=%s)", fmt_n({consort_counts["total_ed_encounters"]}))
    hadm_txt <- sprintf(
      "ED encounters linked to hospital admission (hadm_id present)\\n(n=%s)",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["ed_encounters_with_hadm"]})
    )
    ex_hadm_txt <- sprintf(
      "Excluded (n=%s): no linked hadm_id",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["excluded_no_hadm"]})
    )
    hypercap_txt <- sprintf(
      "Meets hypercapnia evidence (ICD OR definitive blood-gas PCO2)\\n(n=%s)",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["hypercap_evidence_rows"]})
    )
    ex_hypercap_txt <- sprintf(
      "Excluded (n=%s): no qualifying ICD or blood-gas hypercapnia evidence",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["excluded_no_hypercap_evidence"]})
    )
    cc_txt <- sprintf(
      "ED chief complaint present (non-missing, non-pseudomissing)\\n(n=%s)",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["chief_complaint_present_rows"]})
    )
    ex_cc_txt <- sprintf(
      "Excluded (n=%s): missing/pseudo-missing ED chief complaint",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["excluded_missing_or_pseudomissing_cc"]})
    )
    final_txt <- sprintf(
      "Final study cohort exported (MIMICIV all with CC_with_NLP.xlsx)\\n(n=%s)",
      fmt_n({consort_counts["final_study_rows"]})
    )

    options(txt_gp = grid::gpar(cex = 0.85))
    consort_graph <- add_box(txt = entry_txt) |>
      add_box(txt = hadm_txt) |>
      add_side_box(txt = ex_hadm_txt) |>
      add_box(txt = hypercap_txt) |>
      add_side_box(txt = ex_hypercap_txt) |>
      add_box(txt = cc_txt) |>
      add_side_box(txt = ex_cc_txt) |>
      add_box(txt = final_txt) |>
      add_label_box(txt = c(
        "1" = "Base MIMIC-IV ED population",
        "3" = "Hypercapnia evidence requirement",
        "5" = "Chief-complaint requirement and final cohort"
      ))

    grDevices::png("{consort_png_path.as_posix()}", width = 34, height = 22, units = "cm", res = 300, type = "cairo")
    plot(consort_graph)
    invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
    """
).strip()

consort_render = subprocess.run(
    ["Rscript", "-e", r_code],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
if consort_render.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "CONSORT diagram rendering failed via Rscript.\n"
        f"STDOUT:\n{consort_render.stdout}\n\nSTDERR:\n{consort_render.stderr}"
    )

note_export(consort_png_path)
note_export(consort_counts_path)
consort_image = plt.imread(consort_png_path)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5, 7.5))
ax.imshow(consort_image)
ax.axis("off")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
plt.close(fig)

# R may emit a default graphics side artifact (Rplots.pdf) in the working
# directory during scripted plotting. It is not part of pipeline outputs.
rplots_seen: set[Path] = set()
for rplots_path in (WORK_DIR / "Rplots.pdf", OUTPUT_DIR / "Rplots.pdf"):
    resolved_path = rplots_path.expanduser().resolve()
    if resolved_path in rplots_seen:
        continue
    rplots_seen.add(resolved_path)
    if resolved_path.exists():
        quiet_unlink(resolved_path, verbose=VERBOSE_RENDER)
```

## Association Model

Logistic regression of respiratory symptom flag on hypercapnia definitions.

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-010
model_df = df.copy()
model_df["is_respiratory"] = model_df["has_group_respiratory"].fillna(0).astype(int)

predictor_df = model_df[HYPERCAP_CRITERIA].copy()
non_constant_predictors = [
    column for column in HYPERCAP_CRITERIA if predictor_df[column].nunique(dropna=True) > 1
]
outcome = model_df["is_respiratory"]
model_status = "ok"
model_message = ""

if not non_constant_predictors:
    model_status = "skipped"
    model_message = "Association model skipped: all hypercapnia predictors are constant in this run."
    print(model_message)
    or_table = pd.DataFrame(index=HYPERCAP_CRITERIA, columns=["OR", "CI_lo", "CI_hi", "p"])
else:
    design_matrix = sm.add_constant(
        predictor_df[non_constant_predictors], has_constant="add"
    )
    try:
        logit_result = sm.Logit(outcome, design_matrix, missing="drop").fit(disp=False)
        fitted_table = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "OR": np.exp(logit_result.params),
                "CI_lo": np.exp(logit_result.conf_int()[0]),
                "CI_hi": np.exp(logit_result.conf_int()[1]),
                "p": logit_result.pvalues,
            }
        )
        or_table = (
            fitted_table.reindex(HYPERCAP_CRITERIA)
            .astype(float, copy=False)
            .round(3)
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        model_status = "skipped"
        model_message = (
            "Association model skipped due to singular/ill-conditioned design matrix: "
            f"{exc}"
        )
        print(model_message)
        or_table = pd.DataFrame(index=HYPERCAP_CRITERIA, columns=["OR", "CI_lo", "CI_hi", "p"])

display(or_table.loc[HYPERCAP_CRITERIA])
```

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-011b

figure1_vbg_flag = to_binary_flag(analytic_df["vbg_hypercap_threshold"]).eq(1)

figure1_route_counts = {
    "Gas-only": int((figure1_gas_flag & ~figure1_icd_flag).sum()),
    "Both ICD and blood-gas criteria": int((figure1_gas_flag & figure1_icd_flag).sum()),
    "ICD-only": int((~figure1_gas_flag & figure1_icd_flag).sum()),
}
figure1_source_counts = {
    "Blood-gas subset": int(figure1_gas_flag.sum()),
    "ABG criteria met": int(figure1_abg_flag.sum()),
    "VBG criteria met": int(figure1_vbg_flag.sum()),
    "ICD-positive": int(figure1_icd_flag.sum()),
}
figure1_expected_counts = {

}

if figure1_route_counts != figure1_route_df_counts:
    raise AssertionError(
        f"Figure 1 inclusion-route counts from flags do not match inclusion_route splits: "
        f"flags={figure1_route_counts}, route_column={figure1_route_df_counts}"
    )
if sum(figure1_route_counts.values()) != int(len(analytic_df)):
    raise AssertionError(
        f"Figure 1 mutually exclusive route counts sum to {sum(figure1_route_counts.values()):,}, "
        f"not analytic cohort N={len(analytic_df):,}"
    )
if figure1_route_counts["Gas-only"] + figure1_route_counts["Both ICD and blood-gas criteria"] != figure1_source_counts["Blood-gas subset"]:
    raise AssertionError("Figure 1 gas-only plus both-route count does not equal the blood-gas subset count.")
if figure1_route_counts["ICD-only"] + figure1_route_counts["Both ICD and blood-gas criteria"] != figure1_source_counts["ICD-positive"]:
    raise AssertionError("Figure 1 ICD-only plus both-route count does not equal the ICD-positive count.")
for count_name, expected_count in figure1_expected_counts.items():
    observed_count = {**figure1_route_counts, **figure1_source_counts}[count_name]
    if observed_count != expected_count:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"Figure 1 {count_name} count drifted: observed {observed_count:,}; expected {expected_count:,}."
        )

def figure1_count_row(

) -> dict[str, object]:
```

## Clinical outcomes and ventilation regression

Retain the manuscript-adjacent outcomes figures and workbooks inside the merged notebook.

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-011c
regression_df = biochemical_df.dropna(
    subset=[
        "ph_band",
        "imv_flag",
        "niv_flag",
        "any_hypercap_icd",
        "abg_hypercap_threshold",
        "vbg_hypercap_threshold",
    ]
).copy()
regression_df["resp_group"] = np.where(regression_df["has_group_respiratory"].eq(1), "Respiratory", "Non-respiratory")
model_imv = smf.logit(
    """
    imv_flag ~ C(resp_group, Treatment(reference='Non-respiratory'))
    + C(ph_band, Treatment(reference='≥7.35'))
    + any_hypercap_icd
    + abg_hypercap_threshold
    + vbg_hypercap_threshold
    """,
    data=regression_df,
).fit(disp=False)
model_niv = smf.logit(
    """
    niv_flag ~ C(resp_group, Treatment(reference='Non-respiratory'))
    + C(ph_band, Treatment(reference='≥7.35'))
    + any_hypercap_icd
    + abg_hypercap_threshold
    + vbg_hypercap_threshold
    """,
    data=regression_df,
).fit(disp=False)

or_imv = model_or_table(model_imv)
or_niv = model_or_table(model_niv)
ventilation_regression_workbook_path = write_excel_export(
    "ventilation_regression_workbook",
    {
        "IMV_Logistic_Regression": (or_imv.rename_axis("Predictor").reset_index(), False),
        "NIV_Logistic_Regression": (or_niv.rename_axis("Predictor").reset_index(), False),
    },
)
label_map = {
    "Intercept": "Intercept",
    "C(resp_group, Treatment(reference='Non-respiratory'))[T.Respiratory]": "Respiratory presentation",
    "C(ph_band, Treatment(reference='≥7.35'))[T.7.20–7.29]": "pH 7.20–7.29",
    "C(ph_band, Treatment(reference='≥7.35'))[T.7.30–7.34]": "pH 7.30–7.34",
    "C(ph_band, Treatment(reference='≥7.35'))[T.<7.20]": "pH < 7.20",
```

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-012
#| echo: false
registered_excel_paths = [

]

]

]
for obsolete_path in obsolete_manuscript_paths:

expected_outputs = [

]

verification_rows = []
for output_path in expected_outputs:
    verification_rows.append(
        {
            "path": display_path(output_path),
            "exists": output_path.exists(),
            "size_bytes": output_path.stat().st_size if output_path.exists() else 0,
        }
    )

output_verification = pd.DataFrame(verification_rows)
display(output_verification)
display(pd.DataFrame(analysis_export_registry).T.reset_index(names="export_key"))

registered_filenames = {spec["filename"] for spec in analysis_export_registry.values()}
registered_asset_names = {
    spec["manuscript_asset_name"]
    for spec in analysis_export_registry.values()
    if str(spec.get("manuscript_asset_name", "")).strip()
}
legacy_manuscript_names = {
    "Figure 1_NEW.xlsx",
    "Figure 2_NEW.xlsx",
    "Figure7_Underlying_Data.xlsx",
    "timing_acidemia_summary.xlsx",
}

definition_sensitivity_df = (
    analytic_df.loc[analytic_df["rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"].notna(), [
        "rfv_primary_label_sensitivity",
        *HYPERCAP_CRITERIA,
    ]]
    .melt(
        id_vars=["rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"],
        value_vars=HYPERCAP_CRITERIA,
        var_name="Hypercapnia_Definition",
        value_name="definition_flag",
    )
)
definition_sensitivity_df = definition_sensitivity_df.loc[definition_sensitivity_df["definition_flag"].eq(1)].copy()
definition_sensitivity_summary = (
    definition_sensitivity_df.groupby(
        ["Hypercapnia_Definition", "rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"],
        dropna=False,
    )
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="n_with_category")
    .rename(columns={"rfv_primary_label_sensitivity": "category"})
)
definition_sensitivity_group_sizes = (
    definition_sensitivity_df.groupby("Hypercapnia_Definition", dropna=False)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="N_group")
)
definition_sensitivity_summary = definition_sensitivity_summary.merge(
    definition_sensitivity_group_sizes,
    on="Hypercapnia_Definition",
    how="left",
    validate="many_to_one",
)
definition_sensitivity_summary["pct_of_encounters"] = (
    definition_sensitivity_summary["n_with_category"]
    / definition_sensitivity_summary["N_group"].replace(0, np.nan)
    * 100
).fillna(0.0)

timing_sensitivity_summary = (
    timing_df.loc[timing_df["rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"].notna()]
    .groupby(["gas_timing_stratum", "rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"], dropna=False)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="n_with_category")
    .rename(columns={"rfv_primary_label_sensitivity": "category"})
)
timing_sensitivity_group_sizes = (
    timing_df.loc[timing_df["rfv_primary_label_sensitivity"].notna()]
    .groupby("gas_timing_stratum", dropna=False)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="N_group")
)
timing_sensitivity_summary = timing_sensitivity_summary.merge(
    timing_sensitivity_group_sizes,
    on="gas_timing_stratum",
    how="left",
    validate="many_to_one",
)
timing_sensitivity_summary["pct_of_encounters"] = (
    timing_sensitivity_summary["n_with_category"]
    / timing_sensitivity_summary["N_group"].replace(0, np.nan)
    * 100
).fillna(0.0)

definition_prevalence_compare = definition_counts_df.merge(
    definition_sensitivity_summary[
        ["Hypercapnia_Definition", "category", "pct_of_encounters"]
    ],
    on=["Hypercapnia_Definition", "category"],
    how="outer",
    suffixes=("_primary", "_sensitivity"),
).fillna({"pct_of_encounters_primary": 0.0, "pct_of_encounters_sensitivity": 0.0})
timing_prevalence_compare = timing_counts_df.merge(
    timing_sensitivity_summary[
        ["gas_timing_stratum", "category", "pct_of_encounters"]
    ],
    on=["gas_timing_stratum", "category"],
    how="outer",
    suffixes=("_primary", "_sensitivity"),
).fillna({"pct_of_encounters_primary": 0.0, "pct_of_encounters_sensitivity": 0.0})
definition_prevalence_compare = definition_prevalence_compare.loc[
    ~definition_prevalence_compare["category"].eq(RFV_UNCODABLE_LABEL)
].copy()
timing_prevalence_compare = timing_prevalence_compare.loc[
    ~timing_prevalence_compare["category"].eq(RFV_UNCODABLE_LABEL)
].copy()
primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance = 0.011

analysis_qc_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []

def add_qc_check(name: str, passed: bool, severity: str, details: str) -> None:
    analysis_qc_rows.append(
        {
            "check_name": name,
            "passed": bool(passed),
            "severity": severity,
            "details": details,
        }
    )

render_hygiene_ok = not bool(
    output_verification["path"].astype("string").str.contains(r"/Users/|PosixPath\(", regex=True).any()
)
manuscript_assets_exist = all(path.exists() for path in manuscript_expected_paths)

definition_sensitivity_sum = (
    definition_sensitivity_summary.groupby("Hypercapnia_Definition", dropna=False)["pct_of_encounters"]
    .sum()
)
timing_sensitivity_sum = (
    timing_sensitivity_summary.groupby("gas_timing_stratum", dropna=False)["pct_of_encounters"]
    .sum()
)

add_qc_check(
    "label_count_bounds",
    bool(analytic_df["label_count"].between(0, 5).all()),
    "error",
    f"max_label_count={int(analytic_df['label_count'].max())}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "no_blank_canonical_labels",
    bool(
        not rfv_label_coverage_audit["canonical_label"].astype("string").str.strip().eq("").any()
    ),
    "error",
    f"canonical_labels_observed={len(rfv_label_coverage_audit)}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "canonical_label_mapping_complete",
    bool(rfv_label_coverage_audit["covered_by_mapping"].all()),
    "error",
    f"uncovered_labels={rfv_label_coverage_audit.loc[~rfv_label_coverage_audit['covered_by_mapping'], 'canonical_label'].tolist()}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "no_mixed_uncodable_labels",
    bool(
        not analytic_df["analytical_label_set"].map(
            lambda labels: RFV_UNCODABLE_LABEL in labels and len(labels) > 1
        ).any()
    ),
    "error",
    f"uncodable_only_n={int(analytic_df['has_uncodable_only'].sum())}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "uncodable_only_has_no_semantic_groups",
    bool(
        not (
            analytic_df["has_uncodable_only"].eq(1)
            & analytic_df["semantic_group_set"].map(len).ne(0)
        ).any()
    ),
    "error",
    f"violations={int(((analytic_df['has_uncodable_only'].eq(1)) & analytic_df['semantic_group_set'].map(len).ne(0)).sum())}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "definition_prevalence_bounds",
    bool(definition_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"].between(0, 100).all()),
    "error",
    f"rows={len(definition_counts_df)}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "timing_prevalence_bounds",
    bool(timing_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"].between(0, 100).all()),
    "error",
    f"rows={len(timing_counts_df)}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "primary_ge_sensitivity_definition",
    bool(
        (
            definition_prevalence_compare["pct_of_encounters_primary"]
            >= definition_prevalence_compare["pct_of_encounters_sensitivity"]
            - primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance
        ).all()
    ),
    "error",
    (
        "violations="
        f"{int((definition_prevalence_compare['pct_of_encounters_primary'] < definition_prevalence_compare['pct_of_encounters_sensitivity'] - primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance).sum())}"
        f"; tolerance={primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance:.3f}"
    ),
)
add_qc_check(
    "primary_ge_sensitivity_timing",
    bool(
        (
            timing_prevalence_compare["pct_of_encounters_primary"]
            >= timing_prevalence_compare["pct_of_encounters_sensitivity"]
            - primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance
        ).all()
    ),
    "error",
    (
        "violations="
        f"{int((timing_prevalence_compare['pct_of_encounters_primary'] < timing_prevalence_compare['pct_of_encounters_sensitivity'] - primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance).sum())}"
        f"; tolerance={primary_vs_sensitivity_tolerance:.3f}"
    ),
)
add_qc_check(
    "sensitivity_definition_sums_to_100",
    bool((definition_sensitivity_sum.sub(100).abs() <= 0.5).all()),
    "error",
    f"max_abs_deviation={definition_sensitivity_sum.sub(100).abs().max():.3f}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "sensitivity_timing_sums_to_100",
    bool((timing_sensitivity_sum.sub(100).abs() <= 0.5).all()),
    "error",
    f"max_abs_deviation={timing_sensitivity_sum.sub(100).abs().max():.3f}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "render_hygiene_source_scan",
    render_hygiene_ok,
    "warning",
    "Verified exported output paths are display-safe in default render mode.",
)
add_qc_check(
    "manuscript_assets_exist",
    manuscript_assets_exist,
    "error",
    f"missing_assets={[display_path(path) for path in manuscript_expected_paths if not path.exists()]}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "canonical_manuscript_assets_registered",
    registered_asset_names == set(MANUSCRIPT_ASSET_FILENAMES.values()),
    "error",
    f"registered_assets={sorted(registered_asset_names)}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "obsolete_figure_5_assets_absent",
    all(not path.exists() for path in obsolete_manuscript_paths),
    "error",
    f"remaining_obsolete_assets={[display_path(path) for path in obsolete_manuscript_paths if path.exists()]}",
)
add_qc_check(
    "legacy_manuscript_names_absent_from_registry",
    not bool(legacy_manuscript_names & registered_filenames),
    "error",
    f"legacy_hits={sorted(legacy_manuscript_names & registered_filenames)}",
)

analysis_qc_checks = pd.DataFrame(analysis_qc_rows)
analysis_qc_json_path = ANALYSIS_QA_DIR / "analysis_qc_checks.json"
analysis_qc_csv_path = ANALYSIS_QA_DIR / "analysis_qc_checks.csv"
analysis_qc_json_path.write_text(json.dumps(analysis_qc_rows, indent=2))
analysis_qc_checks.to_csv(analysis_qc_csv_path, index=False)
note_export(analysis_qc_json_path)
note_export(analysis_qc_csv_path)
display(analysis_qc_checks)
if not analysis_qc_checks["passed"].all():
    failed_checks = analysis_qc_checks.loc[~analysis_qc_checks["passed"], "check_name"].tolist()
    raise AssertionError(f"Analysis QC checks failed: {failed_checks}")
```

```{python}
from datetime import datetime

analysis_manifest = collect_run_manifest(
    WORK_DIR,
    run_id=f"analysis_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}",
)


def _manifest_relpath(path_value: object) -> str | None:
    if path_value is None:
        return None
    path_obj = Path(path_value).expanduser()
    if path_obj.is_absolute():
        try:
            return str(path_obj.resolve().relative_to(WORK_DIR.resolve()))
        except ValueError:
            return f"<external>/{path_obj.name}"
    return str(path_obj)


analysis_manifest["stage"] = "analysis"
analysis_manifest["analysis_input_path"] = _manifest_relpath(ANALYSIS_INPUT_PATH)
analysis_manifest["outputs"] = {
    "registered_excel_exports": analysis_export_registry,
    "upset_output_path": _manifest_relpath(upset_output_path),
    "rfv_upset_output_path": _manifest_relpath(rfv_upset_output_path),
    "timing_prevalence_panel_plot_path": _manifest_relpath(timing_prevalence_panel_plot_path),
    "timing_ci_plot_path": _manifest_relpath(timing_ci_plot_path),
    "rfv_comorbidity_workbook_path": _manifest_relpath(rfv_comorbidity_workbook_path),
    "rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_path": _manifest_relpath(rfv_comorbidity_heatmap_path),
    "analysis_qc_json_path": _manifest_relpath(analysis_qc_json_path),
    "analysis_qc_csv_path": _manifest_relpath(analysis_qc_csv_path),
}
analysis_manifest["output_verification"] = verification_rows
analysis_manifest["analysis_qc_checks"] = analysis_qc_rows
analysis_manifest = sanitize_manifest_payload(analysis_manifest, work_dir=WORK_DIR)
analysis_manifest_path = prior_runs_dir / f"{run_date} analysis_run_manifest.json"
analysis_manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(analysis_manifest, indent=2))
note_export(analysis_manifest_path)
```
